svg.title: DSIP (emideltide): what has actually been tested
svg.desc: DSIP (emideltide): what has actually been tested. Rabbit brain infusion (1977): Discovering lab reports more delta (deep-sleep) EEG waves. Verdict: Positive, animals. Rat replication attempts: One lab found no rise in sleep or delta power; animal results vary. Verdict: Inconsistent. Natural sleep factor in the body: No gene, precursor protein or receptor identified (2006 review). Verdict: Unresolved. Small IV insomnia studies: Positive reports mostly from the discovering group. Verdict: Positive, small. Independent placebo-controlled trials: Two trials (6 and 16 patients): little or weak benefit. Verdict: Not confirmed. Opioid and alcohol withdrawal: Open-label reports only; no control group. Verdict: Uncontrolled. Injection under the skin or nasal spray: FDA found no human data under the skin; nasal: one 2001 brain-wave study. Verdict: Almost none. Registered clinical trials: ClinicalTrials.gov: zero records for DSIP or emideltide. Verdict: None.
